items.title: Securing Internet-Critical Software: How We Could Have Backdoored Bash
items.summary: A shell injection hidden in an email address gave us code execution on GNU Savannah, then root, then the ability to push to the upstream Bash repository. We reported it, kept auditing, and helped the FSF fix 26 vulnerabilities in the forge that hosts GNU.
items.interpretation: 这条消息值得关注的地方，是它揭示的行业趋势：技术创新正在从实验室走向真实业务、监管和规模化落地。

items.title: Embrace: RCE, Address Bar Spoofing and More in Cursor, Codex, Copilot and Claude
items.summary: Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Codex, VS Code and Claude Desktop each built a browser into their AI assistant, then enriched it beyond what a normal browser allows. Those enrichments broke the browser threat model, letting a web page or a local file reach the machine behind it. Two issues remain unpatched.
